steps.title: You have a topic
steps.caption: It starts with you, a topic, and mild overconfidence.

steps.title: The skill interviews you
steps.caption: One question at a time: the topic, the look, then each beat of the story.

steps.title: Answers become steps
steps.caption: Each answer lands as a step card — title, caption, visual — plus what morphs from one step into the next.

steps.title: The deck grows
steps.caption: Same shapes, new beats. Every answer extends the story without redrawing it.

steps.title: You set the depth
steps.caption: Spell out every step, or sketch a few and see how it looks. You hold the gate.

steps.title: It assembles the scene
steps.caption: Your steps are wired into one evolving scene, drawn with a shared scene kit — ready-made boxes, arrows, and motion that make entities morph.

steps.title: It checks its own work
steps.caption: Before saying done, it builds and renders every step — and fixes what breaks.

steps.title: Changed your mind? Loop it.
steps.caption: Point at a step and ask. The skill edits the scene in place — nothing is redrawn from scratch.

steps.title: You're looking at one
steps.caption: This presentation was built exactly this way. Thanks for watching.
